description: This file is the ADOdb Date Library for PHP, providing functions for extended date and time conversions, especially beyond the native 32-bit timestamp range, including custom date formatting, Gregorian calendar support, and timezone handling.

methods.name: adodb_time
methods.description: Returns the current Unix timestamp as an integer or float.

methods.name: adodb_getdate
methods.description: Returns date information array supporting dates beyond the 1901-2038 Unix timestamp range.

methods.name: adodb_date
methods.description: Formats a date/time based on a timestamp with support for dates outside the native range.

methods.name: adodb_mktime
methods.description: Converts a local date/time to timestamp supporting dates outside the 1901-2038 range.

methods.name: adodb_gmdate
methods.description: Formats a GMT date/time based on timestamp.

methods.name: adodb_strftime
methods.description: Locale-aware strftime implementation supporting extended date formats.
